channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Ebola en RDC, une épidémie hors de contrôle ?
item.description: Dans cet épisode d’Afrique 360°, Enrica Picco et Rinaldo Depagne reçoivent Frédéric Manantsoa Lai, coordinateur des urgences pour Médecins Sans Frontières, et Onesphore Sematumba, analyste senior pour la République démocratique du Congo et le Burundi à Crisis Group, pour parler de l’épidémie d’Ebola en RDC et de ses conséquences sur la population congolaise, déjà marquée par des années de conflit.

item.title: Avrupa Birliği ve Türkiye: Savunmada Birlik?
item.description: İkinci Dünya Savaşı sonrasında şekillenen uluslararası düzen giderek çözülürken, Ankara ve diğer Avrupa başkentlerindeki yetkililer güvenlik alanında birlikte hareket etmedikleri takdirde ciddi risklerle karşı karşıya kalacaklarının giderek daha fazla farkına varıyor. Tehdit algıları farklılık gösterse de, pragmatik ve esnek iş birliği yolları geliştirmeleri hâlâ mümkün. Avrupa Birliği ve Türkiye: Savunmada Birlik?

item.title: PM Modi’s SCO visit is loaded with expectations on BRICS Summit and UNSC election
item.description: PM’s visit will focus on strengthening ties with Iran, Tajikistan, and other Central Asian countries; the agenda will include engagements aimed at the upcoming BRICS Summit in September, the two-year UN Security Council term of 2028-2029, and planning for the long-pending India-Central Asia Summit, which has not met since 2022 PM Modi’s SCO visit is loaded with expectations on BRICS Summit and UNSC election.

item.title: 'Why are you trying so hard?' A Primary 1 dropout's gritty journey to becoming a trainee teacher
item.description: After dropping out of primary school aged seven, Mr Presslee Chng endured years of social isolation and bullying. He tells CNA TODAY about his long and bumpy road back to school, the teachers who propped him up along the way, and his dream to pay it forward as a teacher himself. 'Why are you trying so hard?' A Primary 1 dropout's gritty journey to becoming a trainee teacher.

item.title: Nepal floods: Families search for loved ones amid hope and despair at Kathmandu hospitals
item.description: The death toll in the Nepal flash floods continues to rise, as search efforts continue for over 2,400 missing people, three days after the disaster struck. Inside Kathmandu’s National Trauma Centre, the atmosphere is heavy with confusion, raw hope, and growing dread. Exhausted families clustered around hospital pillars, desperately searching lists of rescued survivors for names they know. Nepal floods: Families search for loved ones amid hope and despair at Kathmandu hospitals.

item.title: They laid down arms. Now ex-guerrillas in Colombia fear fate under new hardline president
item.description: ‘Total peace’ plan of previous government led only 99 of Colombia’s 30,000 armed combatants to disarm, but new president Abelardo De la Espriella opposes peace agreementsIn mid-June, 99 guerrilla fighters were flown by helicopter to a small settlement in a rural area of southern Colombia where they lined up and, one by one, handed their weapons to government officials: rifles, pistols, machine gun.

item.title: Russia's 'Make Or Break' Airliner Approaches Production Amid Sanctions And Shortages
item.description: An "all-Russian" MC-21 passenger jet made its first test flight in early August, marking a step closer to full production, due to begin in 2027. But years of geopolitical turbulence have pushed the project far off-course, aviation insiders say. Russia's 'Make Or Break' Airliner Approaches Production Amid Sanctions And Shortages.

item.title: Ukrainian Drone Spots SOS, Sparking 3-Day Rescue From Frontline Village

item.title: Civilian risks grow as military activity continues, UN says
item.description: Damaged roads, disrupted services and ongoing military activity continue to put civilians at risk in south Lebanon as strikes between Israeli forces and Hezbollah continue, according to the UN’s peacekeeping mission in the country (UNIFIL).
